R01.question: Create an executive inventory health report as of 2022-12-31 with stock, reorder, stockout and overstock signals.
R01.expected_behavior: Present title, as-of/period, KPI definitions, summary, evidence-backed findings, limitations and decision recommendations without authorizing actions.

health.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS observed_products,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand,SUM(i.units_sold) AS units_sold,SUM(i.units_received) AS units_received,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stockout_flag) AS stockout_products,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.overstock_flag) AS overstock_products,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.reorder_flag) AS reorder_products FROM commerce.inventory i WHERE i.snapshot_date = DATE '2022-12-31'

category_health.sql: SELECT p.category,COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS observed_products,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand,SUM(i.stockout_days) AS stockout_product_days,AVG(i.fill_rate) AS mean_stored_fill_rate,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.stockout_flag) AS stockout_products,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.overstock_flag) AS overstock_products,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.reorder_flag) AS reorder_products FROM commerce.inventory i JOIN commerce.products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = DATE '2022-12-31' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

R01.limitations: Historical snapshots are observations, not live stock or proof of operational execution. Missing snapshots are not zero. Stored ratios are unweighted averages unless stated; stockout_days sums are product-days. Flags can overlap. Detail references are capped at 200 with stable ordering; aggregates are computed before limits. No currency may be inferred. Inventory units_sold and order quantities are different sources, not automatically reconcilable. Catalog cogs is only a labelled cost proxy, not approved valuation or accounting margin. Returned units divided by ordered units in separate calendar-year windows is a unit ratio, not the canonical order-based return_rate or a matched-cohort rate. No approved reorder quantities, safety stock, lead times, supplier receipt compliance, warehouse sellable stock, actual product ages, or returned-stock disposition are available. Recommendations require human approval and do not authorize purchase orders or stock changes.
R01.policy_reference_limit: Dataset supplies policy identifier/page, not policy passages. No invented policy text is used as gold.
